content_sections.heading: About Chennai District Collector Recruitment
content_sections.text: This notice is issued by the Chennai District Collector for posts at the District Hub for Empowerment of Women, linked to Mission Shakti. It covers specialist, accounts, IT and support posts, all on consolidated monthly pay.

content_sections.heading: Chennai District Collector Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: The notice prints one deadline only. The notice does not print a separate application start date.

content_sections.heading: Vacancies by Project / Block
content_sections.text: The notice lists 6 vacancies in total, all at the District Hub for Empowerment of Women, Chennai. The Gender Specialist post has the most vacancies, with 2 of the 6.

rows.post: Gender Specialist (Gender Specialist-1 and Gender Specialist-2)

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The upper age limit is 35 years for all five posts. The notice does not print an age cut-off date or any age relaxation, and does not state a residence or gender condition apart from the MTS preference below. Education: graduate in Social Work, Social Disciplines, Life Sciences or other related social science fields. Preferred: a postgraduate degree. Experience: minimum 3 years of work experience with government or non-governmental organizations, dealing with gender-focused themes, community mobilization or women's empowerment. Upper age limit: 35 years. Pay: Rs. 21,000 (each). Education: bachelor's degree in Economics, Banking or similar disciplines. Preferred: a postgraduate degree. Experience: minimum 3 years working with government or non-governmental organizations, centred on financial literacy and financial inclusion themes. Upper age limit: 35 years. Pay: Rs. 21,000. Education: a graduate degree or a diploma in accounts, or another discipline with accounts studied as a subject. Experience: minimum 3 years of working experience with government or non-government organizations in a related domain. Upper age limit: 35 years. Pay: Rs. 20,000. Education: a graduation degree with working knowledge in computers, IT or related fields. Experience: minimum 3 years, which must include data management, process documentation and web-based reporting. Sector: experience at State or District level, working with government, non-governmental (NGO) or IT-based organizations. Upper age limit: 35 years. Pay: Rs. 20,000. Education: at least passed SSLC (10th standard). Language: must be able to read and write in both English and Tamil. Skills: basic computer literacy and typing knowledge. Preference will be given to widows, destitute women and spinsters (unmarried women). Upper age limit: 35 years. Pay: Rs. 12,000. The notice states each post's salary as consolidated per month. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Chennai District Collector Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the application format from the official website, https://chennai.nic.in . Fill in the application format for the post applied for. Submit the application to the Chennai office named in the notice (Chennai - 600 001) so that it is received by 5.00 PM on 20.11.2026. The notice prints the full postal address in a script that could not be reproduced here, and the extracted text does not list the documents to enclose. Both are in the official notification.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in the Chennai District Collector recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 6 vacancies: 2 Gender Specialist and 1 each of Specialist in Financial Literacy, Account Assistant, IT Assistant for Mission Shakti and Multi-Tasking Staff.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date is 20 November 2026, 5.00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the MTS post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have at least passed SSLC (10th standard), be able to read and write English and Tamil, and have basic computer literacy and typing knowledge.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 35 years for all five posts.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for each post?
faq.answer: Consolidated pay per month is Rs. 21,000 for Gender Specialist (each) and Specialist in Financial Literacy, Rs. 20,000 for Account Assistant and IT Assistant, and Rs. 12,000 for MTS.

faq.question: Q6. How much experience is required?
faq.answer: A minimum of 3 years is required for Gender Specialist, Specialist in Financial Literacy, Account Assistant and IT Assistant. The notice prints no experience requirement for MTS.

faq.question: Q7. Where can I get the application format?
faq.answer: The application format is available on https://chennai.nic.in.

faq.question: Q8. Who gets preference for the MTS post?
faq.answer: Preference will be given to widows, destitute women and spinsters (unmarried women).

faq.question: Q9. Is a postgraduate degree required for the specialist posts?
faq.answer: No. For Gender Specialist and Specialist in Financial Literacy a postgraduate degree is only preferred; the essential qualification is a graduate or bachelor's degree in the stated disciplines.
